title: Qualify smoke-to-cloth drag
requires: Any development host and one physical production driver advertising the exact capability tuple
scope: Publish and bind vendor-neutral qualification for exactly CLOTH/SMOKE/DISTINCT_FAMILY/DRAG/SECOND_TO_FIRST/SMOKE_GRID; CLOTH/SMOKE/DISTINCT_FAMILY/DRAG/SECOND_TO_FIRST/SMOKE_PARTICLE. The single physical behavior is: Particle and grid smoke flow applies bounded velocity-dependent one-way loading to cloth without requiring contact.
acceptance: Publish one immutable analytic profile for the listed tuple or representation variants, with canonical public-API inputs, SI units, bounded tolerances and an oracle independent of driver-private state.

Add exact bounded capacity, replacement, removal and rollback lifecycle checks for the grid tuple; retain the particle tuple's existing lifecycle binding, and prove rejected mutations preserve the last usable state.

Bind only the exact tuple records in capability-obligations-v1 and rebuild the evidence index; retain failures, leave unrecaptured drivers unqualified, and remove any production advertisement that cannot satisfy the contract.
